_header: tests/fixtures/native_ua_token_cases.json (AGF-7211): the pinned contract of the MYRAai User-Agent token.
Grammar: MYRAai-<Android|iOS>/<head>[ / <osname> <osver> / <arch>( / <key>=<value>)*] running to the END of the user_agent.
CORE (head, osname == platform, osver 1..32 [A-Za-z0-9._-], arch 1..16 [A-Za-z0-9_-]): any failure -> native_os absent + _native_os_invalid.

OPTIONAL (sdk 1..9999 integer, build/display 1..64 [A-Za-z0-9._-], patch YYYY-MM-DD with month 01-12 and day 01-31 (range check only, no per-month calendar check: 2025-02-31 is accepted, 2025-13-45 / 2025-00-10 / 2025-12-32 / 2025-02-00 are dropped + marker); unknown [a-z][a-z0-9_]* keys with value 0..64 of the class are ignored): judged per segment; a bad one is skipped + _native_os_invalid, the rest stays.

PRODUCER RULES (AGF-7212 Android, AGF-7213 iOS): emit sdk only as an integer 1..9999; patch only if YYYY-MM-DD (month 01-12, day 01-31); build/display after replacing every character outside [A-Za-z0-9._-] with '_' and cutting to 64, and OMIT the segment when the result is empty; the core osver likewise (replace, cut to 32, empty RELEASE -> 'unknown'). HEAD: version ^[0-9][0-9.]*$ max 32 chars, build digits only max 10, device 1..128 bytes that must not contain ' / ': replace every character outside [A-Za-z0-9._-] with '_' and cut to 128 bytes (an empty device is rejected, so substitute a non-empty fallback). The whole User-Agent carries exactly one `MYRAai-`: every field and the platform default UA turn any `MYRAai-` into `MYRAai_`. A producer following these rules never triggers _native_os_invalid. iOS (AGF-7213): the device class is [A-Za-z0-9._,-] (the raw utsname.machine such as iPhone15,2 keeps its comma; Android's stricter class is unaffected and a subset); a head version or build that is off its class is replaced by '0' so the core OS facts survive; the build segment is the OS build (sysctl kern.osversion), omitted when unavailable or empty. iOS cannot rewrite the WebKit default UA (Apple-fixed text, no user/vendor-controlled part): the app token is appended by WebKit and DeviceTokenGuards proves the real UA carries exactly one `MYRAai-`.

Producer cases may carry an `android` object (AGF-7212: version_name, version_code, manufacturer, model, release, abi, sdk_int, build_id, display, security_patch (JSON null = Build field null), optional default_ua): the raw Android inputs; the Kotlin test asserts NativeUaToken output equals the token in `ua` (the whole `ua` when default_ua is given). The Lua unit ignores the key.

Producer cases may carry an `ios` object (AGF-7213: version, build, machine, system_version, os_build (JSON null = unavailable), default_ua = the WebKit default UA the token is appended to): the raw iOS inputs; the Swift test asserts `ua == default_ua + " " + NativeUaToken.token(...)`. The Lua unit ignores the key.
expect: "absent" (no key, no marker) | "malformed" (no native_os, _native_os_invalid) | {native_os} (exact object, no marker) | {native_os, invalid:true} (partial).
